assumptions.description: Use one rural external-source archetype for the target whose site/lifestyle mixture is unspecified. Ghana/Malawi population relationships do not identify the selected Kenyan target; same-paper constraints are dependent and participant non-overlap across studies is unaudited.
Transport selected source summaries despite source age/health/residence restrictions. No source exclusions for pregnancy, HIV, diabetes, fasting or health are applied to target rows.

Treat BMI definitions and mmol/L lipid numbers as usable on the requested scale despite unverified assay/specimen/fasting equivalence: source central laboratory serum/unknown matrix versus target CardioChek Plus venous EDTA and unknown fasting.

Source weighting remains not_reported. Use reported aggregate values as constants in an unweighted model; this is an assumption and cannot make source-semantic feedback computable or relabel unknown weighting as reported none.

Treat Agongo reported marginal sample SDs as population dispersion anchors under unknown denominator convention and transport; do not treat them as conditional residual SDs, SEs or uncertainty in transported parameters.

For each biomarker assume equal log variance in male/female source-label strata mapped to M/F. Decompose pooled arithmetic variance using the balanced mixture and geometric ratio; no sex-specific dispersion is reported as such.
Transfer only Greiner rural Malawi female/male geometric mean ratios to log location differences. Do not impose their absolute means or convert geometric means to arithmetic without the declared law.

Transfer the pooled rural Ashanti unadjusted Spearman matrix as within-sex rank dependence; this strong conditioning bridge is unreported. Pooled output ranks need not equal the source ranks after sex shifts.
Use a continuous Gaussian copula. Convert source Spearman r to latent normal 2*sin(pi*r/6); neither this latent Pearson nor raw residual Pearson is reported by the source.

Use sex-conditional multivariate lognormal biomarkers with finite Gaussian covariance, positivity and all polynomial moments finite. No clipping/rejection or TC>=HDL selection; occasional reversed measured lipids are a disclosed model limitation.

Assume age independent of the biomarker vector conditional on sex. This deliberately chosen simplification is not inferred from absent evidence and removes within-sex age confounding from population OLS; age-dependent biological relations remain unidentified.

Use reported rural Malawi sex quartiles as continuous quantile locations. Assume linear lower three quarters, cap90, upper-quarter inverse CDF q75+(90-q75)*(1-sqrt(1-v)). Quantile convention and age maximum are unreported; cap90 is not an eligibility restriction.
F probability .5 is an assumed balanced composition, not target or source estimated composition; sample sex counts fluctuate by iid draws.
Map source women/men summaries to literal target F/M as an explicit assumption. The target field's biological label legend has not been independently verified in admitted metadata.

Derive the requested raw unweighted OLS projections and Pearson residual statistic from the whole assumed law; never substitute Spearman or unresolved log slopes. Delivered lipids mmol/L; multiplying by38.67 and five is a numerical unit/effect-scale map, not an assay bridge.
Use task-prescribed3000 rows and unique sequential string identifiers. Row count and seed do not add clinical evidence or quantify source/transport/model uncertainty.

n_rows.derivation: Exactly task.n_rows; no target observed count supplied.

female_probability.derivation: Balanced Bernoulli scenario; not derived from source sex counts.

age.derivation: Reported rural Malawi M quartiles24/33/46 and F25/34/48; task minimum18; assumed90 and half-power upper-quarter quantile tail. Source women/men mapping to F/M explicitly assumed.

age_biomarker_conditional_independence.derivation: Structural scenario independence, explicitly true; not identified by reported evidence.

biomarker_order.derivation: Ordered BMI/TC/HDL schema for the vector law.

marginal_moments.derivation: Original arithmetic moments in source units. With A1=(1-p)+p*r and A2=(1-p)+p*r^2, v=ln((1+sd^2/mean^2)*A1^2/A2), a=ln(mean)-ln(A1)-v/2; not conditional dispersion inputs.

female_to_male_geometric_ratios.derivation: Ratio of reported female and male geometric means for each variable; log ratio is a sex shift under the equal-logvariance law. Not arithmetic means or independent CI-derived precision.

copula_spearman.derivation: Three rural pooled unadjusted rank correlations from the same Table7 triangle are assumed within sex, then mapped R_ij=2*sin(pi*r_ij/6); diagonal1. All raw projections are law-implied, not source reported.
